topic.map_answer: one gap on the map, the Strait of Gibraltar: close it and the sea drains to a salt basin; open it and the Atlantic pours back in

title: Why would the Mediterranean turn into a salt desert?
description:
Why would the Mediterranean Sea turn into a desert of salt? It already did, once.
One gap at Gibraltar closed, the sun drained the sea to a salt basin, and then the Atlantic broke back in, all on the map.
Sources: Wikipedia (Nov 2026). The characters are not advisers.
Maps simplified. Borders as recognised by the country each video is about.
